the hippocampal network is a reverberatory oscillator that is activated via cholinergic inputs and that it is formed by a specific axonal network, which is composed of collaterals of axons of pyramidal cells and axons of inter‐neurons.

the hippocampal theta and gamma network oscillations are generated by the intrinsic hippocampal network, and that the cholinergically activated hippocampal associative pathways are the core element of this network.

the identification of the hippocampal network oscillator and the mechanisms underlying the concurrent expression of oscillatory activities in the hippocampus.
the identification of the hippocampal oscillator core element and the interactions which produce the oscillations and their associated rhythmicities.
the mechanisms that underlie the expression of the hippocampal oscillatory activity.
